vision: Deliver a unified payment admin workspace enabling Treasury Operations to efficiently manage merchant searches, settlements, refunds, and payout approvals with integrated PaymentCore and rail data, automated allocation, anomaly alerts, and audit-ready reporting, all within a secure, compliant architecture.
scope: The epic covers building a Next.js 14 + TypeScript front-end workspace for treasury analysts and managers to interact with payments data sourced from PaymentCore (GraphQL) and Payment Rail (REST) APIs. It supports read-only analytics and authorized payment actions through Payment Actions service, enforcing RBAC for OpsAnalyst, Manager, and Auditor roles. Out of scope: schema modifications, non-enterprise SaaS, or new API development beyond integration gateways.
success_criteria: End-to-end search and payout workflows function within performance constraints (<1.5s search, <4s payout initiation).
Audit logs correctly emitted to Kafka and S3 for 100% of payment actions.
RBAC gating verified across OpsAnalyst, Manager, and Auditor roles with no privilege escalation.
All MVP features released within the 2-week sprint in production environment.

user_stories.title: Search and filter merchants and payment batches in admin workspace
user_stories.i_want: to search and filter merchants and payment batches by date, merchant ID, and status
user_stories.so_that: I can quickly locate specific transactions and reduce manual spreadsheet work

acceptance_criteria.given: the analyst is logged in with OpsAnalyst role
acceptance_criteria.when: they enter a merchant ID or date range in the search bar
acceptance_criteria.then: results load within 1.5s showing merchant and batch data from PaymentCore and Payment Rail APIs

user_stories.title: View settlement timelines for selected payment batches
user_stories.i_want: to drill into settlement timelines across ACH, RTP, and wire payment rails
user_stories.so_that: I can monitor reconciliation progress and identify delays or anomalies

acceptance_criteria.when: the analyst opens the settlement timeline view
acceptance_criteria.then: the UI displays event stream data grouped by rail type fetched via Payment Rail APIs

user_stories.title: Trigger refund or adjustment actions through Payment Actions service
user_stories.i_want: to initiate refund or adjustment workflows directly from payment batch detail view
user_stories.so_that: I can correct payment exceptions without leaving the workspace

acceptance_criteria.when: they click 'Trigger Refund' on a payment
acceptance_criteria.then: the request is sent to Payment Actions service and audit logs emitted to Kafka and S3

user_stories.title: Approve merchant payout with automated allocation rules
user_stories.i_want: to review and approve merchant payouts based on allocation rules
user_stories.so_that: I can ensure correctness and compliance of disbursements before funds are released

acceptance_criteria.then: the payout is processed via Payment Rail API and audit log written to Kafka and S3

user_stories.title: Generate and export audit-ready reports of payment actions
user_stories.i_want: to export reports of all payment actions within a defined period
user_stories.so_that: I can provide evidence for SOX audits and compliance reviews

acceptance_criteria.given: the auditor has Auditor role access
acceptance_criteria.when: they select a date range and export report
acceptance_criteria.then: an audit-ready CSV or XLSX file is generated from S3 archives and available for download

user_stories.title: Display real-time anomaly alerts within payment batch views
user_stories.i_want: to see alerts for anomalies such as delayed settlements or mismatched amounts
user_stories.so_that: I can act promptly on potential payment issues

acceptance_criteria.given: a batch contains anomalies detected by Payment Rail events
acceptance_criteria.when: analysts open the batch detail view
acceptance_criteria.then: the UI highlights alert flags and provides quick links for investigation
